title: Docusaurus Gateway intelligence capture plan
description: Open Command Center with a public-safe filter, ask about allowed demo fleet status through gateway intelligence, record the live gateway answer, and emit docs-ready proof artifacts.

proofTargets.claim: The operator can open gateway intelligence from Command Center.
Gateway intelligence can summarize live allowed demo slot/run state without exposing private project names.

open-command-center.intent: Open Command Center with public demo project filters.

open-cmd-k.intent: Open the Command Center chat/intelligence drawer.

ask-status.intent: Ask for a public-safe summary of allowed demo slots.

record-proof-window.intent: Record the prompt and live answer.
